(defn _parse [it]
  (let [t (next it)]
    (cond
      (= t "[")
      (let [out []
            (loop [current-out out]
              (let [x (_parse it)]
                (if (= x :_END)
                  (return-from _parse current-out)
                  (recur (conj current-out x))))]
        (return-from _parse (reverse out)))
      (= t "{")
      (let [out {}
            (loop [current-out out]
              (let [k (_parse it)]
                (if (= k :_END)
                  (return-from _parse current-out)
                  (let [v (_parse it)]
                    (recur (assoc current-out k v))))]
        (return-from _parse out))
      (= t "]")
      :_:END
      (= t "}")
      :_:END
      :else
      (atom t))))

(defn calibration-summary [pit-values bins]
  (if (empty? pit-values)
    {:n 0 :pit-mean 0.5 :deviation 0.0 :hist []}
    (let [n (length pit-values)
          counts (repeat bins 0)
          counts-after (reduce (fn [acc p]
                                 (let [idx (min (max 0.0 (min 1.0 p)) * bins)
                                       final-idx (min idx (dec bins))]
                                   (update acc (dec final-idx) inc)))
                               counts pit-values)
          freq-list (map #(if (zero? %) 0.0 (/ % n)) counts-after)
          expected (1.0 / bins)
          deviation (reduce (fn acc f -> (+ acc (Math/abs (- f expected)))) 0.0 freq-list)]
      {:n n
       :pit-mean (/ (reduce #(Math/sum % pit-values) 0.0 pit-values) n)
       :deviation deviation
       :hist freq-list})))

        crps-all []
        skill-all []
        pit-all []
        per-origin []]

      (let [scored (filter #(contains? % "crps") (forecast-trail rows target-at method))]

(defn _recalib-params [residuals]
  (let [errs (map (fn [r] (if (contains? r "error") (float (get r "error")) nil)) residuals)
        errs-filtered (vec (filter (fn [e] (not (nil? e))) errs))
        sds (map (fn [r] (if (> (get r "sd") 0) (float (get r "sd")) nil)) residuals)
        sds-filtered (vec (filter (fn [s] (not (nil? s))) sds))]
    (when-empty? errs-filtered
      [0.0 1.0])
    (let [n (count errs-filtered)
          mean-err (/ (reduce #(+ % %) errs-filtered) n)
          resid-std (if (>= n 2)
                        (let [rv (/ (reduce (fn [acc e] (+ acc (Math/pow (- e mean-err) 2)) acc) errs-filtered) (dec n))]
                          (if (> rv 0) (Math.sqrt rv) 0.0))
                        (abs (first errs-filtered)))
          mean-sd (if (empty? sds-filtered) 1.0
                     (let [avg-sd (/ (reduce #(+ % %) sds-filtered) (count sds-filtered))]
                       avg-sd))
          raw (if (> mean-sd 0) (/ resid-std mean-sd) 1.0)]
      [ (round mean-err 6)
        (round (Math/max 0.25 (Math/min 4.0 raw)) 6)
      ]))))

(defn _strip-comments [s]
  (let [out []
        in-str false
        i 0
        n (length s)]
    (loop [i n in-str out]
      (if (= i n)
        (reverse out)
        (let [c (s-at s i)]
          (cond
            (and in-str (= c "\""))
            (let [prev-c (s-at s (- i 1))]
              (if (= prev-c "\\")
                (recur (inc i) in-str (conj out c) out)
                (recur (inc i) false (conj out c) out)))

            (and (not in-str) (= c "\""))
            (recur (inc i) true (conj out c) out)

            (and (not in-str) (= c ";"))
            (let [j (loop [j i]
                       (if (= (s-at s j) "\n") j
                         (recur (inc j) j))]
              (recur (inc j) in-str out))

            (true)
            (recur (inc i) in-str (conj out c) out))))))

(defn s-at [s i]
  (if (>= i 0) (nth s i) nil))
